name: Admin Document Folders
description: Organize admin documents with root-folder sidebar navigation and folder management modals. In the folder manager modal, the 'Nueva carpeta' form's 'Dentro de:' parent selector defaults to the currently active folder, so creating a folder while standing inside a child folder pre-selects that folder as the parent (still changeable to any folder or root). State filtering is an independent axis covered by admin-document-state-filters.
